description: Look up one Canadian patent or application by number in the Canadian Patents Database (CIPO) and get its full bibliographic record: title (English/French), current status, filing date, issue/grant date (blank if not yet granted), owners, applicants, inventors and IPC classification. Accepts the number with or without a "CA" prefix, spaces or dashes — digits only, up to 7 digits.
name: get_cipo_patent
title: Get Cipo Patent
